title: Guide to Medical Interpreter Services: September 2026
summary: Learn how medical interpreter services work across in-person, phone, video, and AI, plus routing, documentation, written materials.
body_markdown:
###


Medical interpreter services support live communication between patients and healthcare professionals who do not share a language comfortably enough for clinical care. The service can include in-person, phone, video, or AI interpretation plus routing, documentation, written-language support, and follow-up workflows.


###


The main delivery modes are in-person interpretation, over-the-phone interpreting, video remote interpreting, and AI medical interpretation. Many healthcare organizations use a mix of these modes.


###


Medical interpretation supports live spoken or signed communication. Medical translation handles written material such as forms, instructions, records, and patient education.


###


Measure time to active interpretation, actual use, failed requests, language coverage, clinically meaningful errors, written-language completion, follow-up completion, and cost per completed interpreted encounter.


###


Yes. AI medical interpretation can provide real-time spoken-language support without waiting for a human interpreter connection. Healthcare organizations should still review clinical testing, quality controls, language coverage, workflow fit, and human support options.
